app.name: Aurora Retail
app.description: Sales administration of the Aurora stores, built with Midnight Indigo: UI and Next.js.

header.title: Sales overview
header.description: Revenue and orders of the Aurora stores. Demo data served by a mock API, without a backend.

kpis.label: Key figures
kpis.monthOverMonth: last month vs. the one before

revenue.title: Revenue by month
revenue.emptyDescription: Change the filters, or go back to the live data.

error.title: The sales data could not be loaded
error.description: The demo service failed on purpose. Try again, or pick another data scenario.

header.title: Orders
header.description: Every order of the year. Sort by a column, filter by status and region, or search by customer, store or number.

listing.title: All orders
listing.caption: All orders
listing.noResultsDescription: Search for another term, or clear the filters to see every order.

header.title: Reports
header.description: One chart of each kind over the sales of the year. Every chart can be read by keyboard and shown as a table.

orders.title: Orders by status
orders.description: Number of orders placed each month

performance.title: Revenue and average ticket
performance.description: Revenue in bars, average ticket on the right axis

stores.title: Revenue by store
stores.description: Total of the orders of each store in the year

goal.title: Monthly goal
goal.description: Revenue of September against the goal of the month
goal.summary: Revenue of September: {{revenue}}, {{share}} of the goal of {{goal}}.

header.title: New customer
header.description: Register a customer of the Aurora stores. The data is checked by the server and not stored: this is a demo.

fields.name: Full name
fields.emailDescription: Used to send receipts. ana.souza@aurora.example is already registered.
fields.phoneDescription: Optional. Area code and number, e.g. (11) 91234-5678.
fields.newsletterDescription: Offers and news of the stores, once a month.

errors.nameTooShort: Enter the full name, with at least 3 letters.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address in the format name@example.com.
errors.emailTaken: This email address is already registered.
errors.phone: Enter the area code and the number: 10 or 11 digits.

header.title: Appearance
header.description: Try a palette, check its contrast and export the theme.json the application is built with.

colors.title: Main colors
colors.description: Every other shade of each intent is derived from its main color.
colors.invalid: Enter a color in the format #RRGGBB or #RGB.
colors.reset: Restore the colors of the build

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The components with the palette above, only in this panel
preview.alertMessage: The sales report of September was generated.

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.description: Every pair of colors the components draw, against the WCAG 2.2 AA minimums
contrast.passMessage: Text, large text and controls reach the minimum contrast on their surfaces.

export.title: theme.json
export.description: Replace src/theme.json with it and build again: the palette is applied on the server, without a flash.
export.copyFailed: The theme could not be copied. Select the text and copy it instead.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: There is no page at this address
notFound.description: It may have moved, or the link may be wrong.

header.title: Icons
header.description: {{sets, number}} open-source icon sets of Iconify, {{icons, number}} icons in all, rendered as inline SVG on the server: no request and no icon data in the browser.

search.title: Search icons
search.queryDescription: Words of the icon name, in English, e.g. arrow left

results.emptyDescription: Try other words, or search every set and license.

details.attribution: Its license (CC BY 4.0) requires crediting the author: keep the attribution page or ICON-NOTICES.md in your application.

details.intents: In the text color of each intent

snippets.dataDescription: Works in Server and Client Components; only this icon reaches the bundle.
snippets.nameDescription: Registers the whole set in a Server Component, so no icon data reaches the browser. On the client, import the data instead.
snippets.copyFailed: The code could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
